summary:
THE DEAD GIRL’S FILE- The corpse is in her early thirties. Mondial, at a glance. Eye color slightly obscured, but most likely gray. Slim build, average height. A birthmark at the base of her neck- a wide diffuse patch of paper-white and hairless skin.
ENCYCLOPEDIA [Legendary: Success]- This is a voidmark. When a pregnant mother is over-exposed to the pale. Other potential symptoms in the children include inconsistent growth patterns, higher sensitivity to psychoactive substances, autoimmune disorders, and chronic anxiety.
INLAND EMPIRE [Challenging: Success]- Something drained out of them, and something foreign placed inside.
Or: A strange murder mystery spirals into something bigger than anyone could have imagined. Harry and Kim think a lot about Revachol, the future, and disco along the way.
